categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the semiconductor specialized equipment sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of photolithography process coating and developing equipment and single-wafer wet process equipment. It has four main business segments: front-end coating and developing equipment, front-end cleaning equipment, back-end advanced packaging equipment, and compound semiconductor small-size equipment. These products cover front-end wafer processing, back-end advanced packaging, and compound semiconductor fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including photolithography coating and developing, physical and chemical cleaning, temporary bonding and debonding for advanced packaging, and SiC wafer dicing. It employs high-precision mechanical arms, ultra-clean microenvironment control, high-throughput HEFEM architecture, and low-damage jet cleaning technologies. The company integrates mechanical, electrical, software, and optical technologies with rigorous quality control and inline process monitoring, achieving international advanced levels in multiple core technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading semiconductor manufacturers such as SMIC, TSMC, Hua Tian Technology, and other top-tier domestic and international wafer fabs and packaging companies. The company serves the integrated circuit manufacturing industry, advanced packaging sector, and compound semiconductor device manufacturers. Its products are critical in semiconductor front-end and back-end processes, addressing markets in logic, power devices, memory, RF, and LED chip production.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenyang and Shanghai, and sales offices covering the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Taiwan regions. It has established subsidiaries in Japan (Kyoto), Guangzhou, and Shenyang to enhance overseas supply chain resources, talent acquisition, and new product development. Overseas sales have been made to multiple international customers, reflecting a growing global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor equipment supply chain, manufacturing specialized equipment used in semiconductor wafer processing and packaging. It also engages in upstream component development and supply chain localization efforts, including core parts like pumps and mechanical arms, aiming for an integrated 'whole machine plus components' development model.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on advancing domestic substitution in critical semiconductor equipment, especially front-end coating and developing machines, chemical cleaning, and advanced packaging equipment aligned with Chiplet technology. It emphasizes continuous R&D investment exceeding 10% of revenue, patent development, and innovation in high-throughput, high-precision, and low-damage technologies. The company also prioritizes talent development, supply chain localization, and expanding product lines to capture emerging markets such as 2.5D/3D packaging and compound semiconductors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor specialized equipment, including photolithography coating and developing machines and single-wafer wet process equipment. Additional income comes from sales of related parts and after-sales services. The company employs a direct sales model supported by a professional sales and service team, with no reliance on distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a domestic leader in coating and developing and single-wafer wet process equipment, competing against global giants like Applied Materials, ASML, Lam Research, Tokyo Electron, and KLA-Tencor. It has successfully broken foreign monopolies in certain segments and is recognized as a national champion in manufacturing. Its products have reached international advanced levels, especially in advanced packaging, positioning it as a strong competitor in the Chinese and global semiconductor equipment markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.72 billion, a 24% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 251 million, up 25%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 4.3 billion with net assets of RMB 2.38 billion, reflecting steady growth and solid financial health. R&D investment accounted for 11.5% of revenue, underscoring its commitment to innovation. Despite negative operating cash flow due to inventory buildup and strategic material stocking, the company maintains robust growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers domestically produced, high-precision semiconductor equipment that breaks foreign monopolies, particularly in front-end coating and developing machines. Its products feature advanced technologies such as ultra-clean microenvironment control, high-throughput mechanical arms, and low-damage cleaning, delivering high yield and stability. It provides integrated solutions closely aligned with customer manufacturing processes, ensuring strong customer stickiness. The company’s continuous innovation, comprehensive product portfolio, and strong after-sales service create significant competitive advantages and value for semiconductor manufacturers.
